jobs.title: Government Security Personnel Analyst
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.
Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.
Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The Government Security Personnel Analyst is responsible for providing personnel security (PERSEC) program support. Duties include, but not limited to: processing SF-86 forms, fingerprinting, maintain data in security databases (SIMS, NBIS, DISS, SWFT, Other), Initial briefings, and Visit Requests (VRs). The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience working clearance/access operations for multi program Defense or Intelligence portfolios.
  • Experience working with government sponsors, PSOs, and industry FSOs across multiple contracts and task orders.
  • Proficiency with DISS, NBIS, SWFT
  • Hands on experience with initial investigations (Tier 3/Tier 5), CE/CV, reciprocity/crossovers, visit requests, and debriefings.
  • Working knowledge of NISP (32 CFR Part 117), DoD adjudicative guidelines, SEAD policies
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication; ability to conduct prescreening interviews, and draft clear correspondence.
  • Analytical Skills: Detail oriented; able to identify data discrepancies, assess risk indicators, and propose mitigations; comfortable with metrics.
  • Review PSQs (e.g., SF 86) for accuracy/completeness against DISS profiles.
  • Maintain accurate personnel, contract, and access records in SIMS; update contract-level access controls, rosters, and billets; reconcile discrepancies.
  • Process, validate, and submit/receive VAR in accordance with sponsor requirements and program timelines

What you need:

  • US Citizenship required/Active Secret eligibility required
  • Knowledge and experience using DISS, NBIS, SWFT, and SIMS along with Microsoft Suite Proficiency
  • Requires Bachelors Degree or equivalent years experience in Personnel Security (1-2 years)

jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer - (Level II Noncommissioned)
jobs.description:
About First Responder Protective Services


First Responder Protective Services is a premier provider of private security needs across the U.S. Our company is owned, operated and managed by U.S. Military veterans, law enforcement executives, and corporate business professionals. Our founders have over 60 years of experience in protecting critical infrastructures, combating transnational criminal organizations, mitigating risks, and providing the highest level of safety and security to corporations and communities.


The mission of First Responder Protective Services is to provide the highest level of customer service to each and every client. We accomplish this mission through our foundation of attention to detail, integrity, accountability, empathy, care, and concern for the needs of our clients and the officers which we serve.


Job Title: Non-Commissioned Security Guard (Level II)
Location: Grapevine
Pay: $18-$20 per hour, depending on qualifications (paid weekly)
Status: Full-time & Part-time

Position Summary


First Responder Protective Services (FRPS) is hiring multiple FLEX Non-Commissioned Security Guards to provide a consistent security presence at a controlled-access community in the Grapevine area. This position is primarily based in a spacious, climate-controlled guard shack, where officers will manage access control, monitor video surveillance and access systems, and check residents and visitors in and out of the property. The guard shack is equipped with basic necessities and access to clean, private restroom facilities. Officers will also conduct occasional patrols of the property, both on foot and by golf cart, to maintain visibility and ensure the safety of residents and property. Weekday and weekend shifts are available, with 24/7 coverage required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage check-in/out residents and visitors in a climate controlled shack.
  • Monitor entrances, access points, and surveillance systems.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, emergencies, or incidents.
  • Prepare detailed incident and activity reports as required.
  • Remain alert and proactive in identifying and reporting security concerns
  • Follow all post orders and supervisor instructions
  • Occasional mobile and foot patrol in assigned areas to ensure safety and security of residents, staff, and property.


Requirements

  • Must have at least one year of experience unarmed security.
  • Must hold a current Level II Texas Noncommissioned Security License
  • Must have a valid Texas Driver’s License (or ability to obtain before starting)
  • Professional appearance and demeanor
  • Ability to work independently or with a team
  • Able to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods


Schedule

Full Time position:

  • Sunday: 10p-6a
  • Monday: 10p-6a
  • Tuesday: 10p-6a
  • Wednesday: 10p-6a
  • Thursday: 10p-6a
  • Friday: OFF
  • Saturday: OFF


Part Time position:

  • Saturday 2p-10p
  • Sunday 2p-10p


Uniform & Equipment

  • FRPS Provides: Uniform shirt, hats, cold weather gear
  • Officer Provides: Duty pants, black boots


Compensation & Advancement

  • Hourly Pay: $18-$20/hour (based on experience and availability)
  • Pay Frequency: Bi-weekly via direct deposit
  • Status: W2 employee (eligible for overtime after 40 hours in a workweek)
  • Shifts: 8 hours per day


Full-Time Employee Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO):
    • 1st Year: Accrue up to 7 days (56 hours)
    • 2nd Year: Accrue up to 10 days (80 hours)
    • 5th Year and beyond: Accrue up to 15 days (120 hours)
  • Health Insurance:
    • Company pays up to $300/month toward employee’s health insurance
    • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage (eligible after first month)
  • Retirement:
    • 401(k) plan with up to 4% company match

Posted By:

First Responder Protective Services
4006 Belt Line Rd, Suite 138
Addison, TX 75001
Texas Department Of Public Safety Private Security Program License # C10520601

First Responder Protective Services is an Equal Employment Opportunity and affirmative action employer. jobs.description:

Pay Rate: $20.00/hour

Schedule

  • Saturday: 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM & 8:00 PM – 8:00 AM
  • Sunday: 8:00 PM – 8:00 AM

Position Summary

We are seeking a reliable and motivated Security Shift Lead to oversee overnight security operations in Desoto, TX. This role is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment while providing leadership, direction, and support to on-duty security personnel. The ideal candidate is experienced, decisive under pressure, and capable of managing incidents professionally.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise and support security officers during assigned shifts
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for incidents and escalations
  • Monitor premises through patrols and surveillance systems
  • Respond to emergencies, incidents, and alarms in a timely manner
  • Prepare detailed incident and daily activity reports
  • Ensure all security protocols and post orders are followed
  • Communicate effectively with management, clients, and team members
  • Assist with training and mentoring of security staff

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of security experience (supervisory experience preferred)
  • Strong leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Ability to assess situations and make sound decisions under pressure
  • Basic computer proficiency (report writing, email, incident systems)
  • Flexible availability, including nights and weekends as needed
  • Must be 21 years of age or older
  • Valid driver’s license required

Preferred Qualities

  • Professional demeanor and strong work ethic
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • High level of integrity and accountability
  • Strong attention to detail

Why Join Us

  • Consistent overnight schedule
  • Opportunity to grow into higher leadership roles
  • Supportive team environment
